import numpy as np
def T(B,n=6,nu=5,R=None):
    B=np.array(B,float);B/=abs(np.linalg.det(B))**(1/3)
    r=range(-n,n+1)
    P=np.array([i*B[0]+j*B[1]+k*B[2] for i in r for j in r for k in r if (i,j,k)!=(0,0,0)])
